ValidationRule.description: Date Paperwork Received cannot be a date in the Future. For reference, check user story #25718 on Gitlab
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF((RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: SKP New Customer Setup") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: SKP Department Add Only") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: DP New Customer Setup") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: DMS") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: New Customer Setup") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: Upsell"), OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Contract_Signed__c)) && ISCHANGED(Date_Paperwork_Received__c ) && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Paperwork_Received__c )) && DATEVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c ) > TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c )) || DATEVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c ) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c )) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Paperwork_Received__c )) && DATEVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c ) > TODAY() ) ), IF((RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: SKP Department Add Only"), OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Date_Paperwork_Received__c ) && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Paperwork_Received__c )) && DATEVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c ) > TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c )) || DATEVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c ) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c )) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Paperwork_Received__c )) && DATEVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c ) > TODAY() ) ), OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Date_Paperwork_Received__c ) && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Paperwork_Received__c )) && DATEVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c ) > TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c )) || DATEVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c ) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c )) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Paperwork_Received__c )) && DATEVALUE(Date_Paperwork_Received__c ) > TODAY() ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date Paperwork Received cannot be a date in the Future.
